##======================================
## Diabetic vs non diabetic (liver)
##======================================

```{r}
plot_diabetes_boxplot <- function(
    all_data,
    diabetic_data,
    panel,
    plot_title = NULL,
    unit_map = NULL
) {

  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(rstatix)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggprism)

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # DATA
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  plot_data <- all_data %>%
  full_join(
    diabetic_data,
    by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    panel_id == .env$panel,
    grepl("Leber_", treatment),
    !str_detect(attribute, "_from_start|dbs|_dbs"),
    !is.na(diabetes),
    !is.na(treatment),
    !is.na(labreads)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = recode(
      treatment,
      "Leber_Diclo" = "Liver_Diclo",
      "Leber_Ibu"   = "Liver_Ibu",
      "Leber_Para"  = "Liver_Para"
    ),
    diabetes = factor(
      diabetes,
      levels = c("Diabetic", "Non_Diabetic")
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    bf_ar_m_nummer,
    labreads,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data available after filtering.")
  }

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Y AXIS SETTINGS
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  y_max <- max(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min <- min(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)

  label_space <- y_max * 0.20

  y_bottom_plot <- y_min - label_space
  y_top_plot    <- y_max * 1.25

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # N COUNTS (PATIENTS)
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  N_counts <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(diabetes) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n_distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      label = paste0("N=", N),
      y = y_bottom_plot - label_space * 1.05
    )

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # n COUNTS (OBSERVATIONS)
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  n_counts <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(diabetes) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      label = paste0("n=", n),
      y = y_max * 1.17
    )

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # P VALUE
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  counts <- table(plot_data$diabetes)

  if (length(counts) == 2 && all(counts >= 3)) {

    pvals <- plot_data %>%
      wilcox_test(labreads ~ diabetes) %>%
      mutate(
        group1 = "Diabetic",
        group2 = "Non_Diabetic",
        y.position = y_max * 1.10,
        p.label = paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))
      )

  } else {

    pvals <- tibble()

  }

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Y LABEL
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  y_label <- if (!is.null(unit_map) && panel %in% names(unit_map)) {
    unit_map[[panel]]
  } else {
    toupper(panel)
  }

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # TITLE
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

 if (is.null(plot_title)) {
  plot_title <- paste0(
    toupper(panel),
    ": Diabetic vs Non-Diabetic (Liver)"
  )
}

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # PLOT
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = diabetes,
      y = labreads,
      fill = diabetes
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.30,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      alpha = 0.3,
      size = 1.8,
      color = "#CC79A7"
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = n_counts,
      aes(
        x = diabetes,
        y = y,
        label = label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 8,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = N_counts,
      aes(
        x = diabetes,
        y = y,
        label = label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 8,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +

    {
      if (nrow(pvals) > 0)
        stat_pvalue_manual(
          pvals,
          label = "p.label",
          xmin = "group1",
          xmax = "group2",
          y.position = "y.position",
          tip.length = 0.01,
          size = 8
        )
    } +

    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(y_bottom_plot, y_top_plot),
      clip = "off"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +

    theme_prism() +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 26,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(b = 3)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 3)
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 24,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 10,
        r = 10,
        b = 30,
        l = 10,
        unit = "pt"
      )
    )

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
base_dir <- here::here("output/figure/diabetes/plots_all_labvalues/liver_T2D_NT2D")

svg_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "svg")
png_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "png")

dir.create(png_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}

p <- plot_diabetes_boxplot(
  all_data      = all_data,
  diabetic_data = diabetic_data,
  panel         = panel,
  plot_title = "MCV: Diabetic vs Non-Diabetic(Liver)",
  unit_map      = unit_map
)

p
```

##===========
## loop 
##===========

```{r}
panels <- unique(all_data$panel_id)

for (panel in panels) {

  cat("Processing:", panel, "\n")

  # Optional: pre-check data exists before plotting
  temp_data <- all_data[all_data$panel_id == panel, ]

  if (nrow(temp_data) == 0) {
    cat("Skipping", panel, "- no data\n")
    next
  }

  p <- tryCatch(
    plot_diabetes_boxplot(
      all_data      = all_data,
      diabetic_data = diabetic_data,
      panel         = panel,
      plot_title    = paste0(toupper(panel),
                             ": Diabetic vs Non-Diabetic"),
      unit_map      = unit_map
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in panel:", panel, "->", e$message, "\n")
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(p)) next

  # Save SVG
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(svg_dir, paste0(panel, "_boxplot.svg")),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 8,
    height   = 6,
    device   = svglite::svglite
  )

  # Save PNG
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(png_dir, paste0(panel, "_boxplot.png")),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 8,
    height   = 6,
    dpi      = 600,
    bg       = "white"
  )
}
```




##=======================================
## Diabetic vs non diabetic (y axis break)
##=======================================

```{r}
library(ggbreak)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggprism)
library(rstatix)

plot_diabetes_boxplot_break <- function(
    all_data,
    diabetic_data,
    panel = "gpt",
    unit_map = NULL,
    plot_title = NULL,
    y_break = c(3000, 4500),
    y_break_scale = 0.3,
    top_margin = 80,
    colors = c(
      "Diabetic"     = "#E15759",
      "Non_Diabetic" = "#4E79A7"
    )
) {

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # TITLE & LABEL
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
  plot_title <- paste0(
    toupper(panel),
    ": Diabetic vs Non-Diabetic (Liver)"
  )
}

  y_label <- if (!is.null(unit_map) &&
                 panel %in% names(unit_map)) {
    unit_map[[panel]]
  } else {
    toupper(panel)
  }

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # DATA
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  plot_data <- all_data %>%
    left_join(
      diabetic_data,
      by = join_by("bf_ar_m_nummer", "treatment"),
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      treatment = recode(
        treatment,
        "Leber_Diclo" = "Liver_Diclo",
        "Leber_Ibu"   = "Liver_Ibu",
        "Leber_Para"  = "Liver_Para"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      panel_id == .env$panel,
      grepl("Liver_", treatment),
      !str_detect(attribute, "_from_start|dbs|_dbs"),
      !is.na(diabetes),
      !is.na(labreads)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diabetes = factor(
        diabetes,
        levels = c("Diabetic", "Non_Diabetic")
      )
    )

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data remaining after filtering.")
  }

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # COUNTS
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  group_stats <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(diabetes) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n_distinct(bf_ar_m_nummer),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  x_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(group_stats$diabetes, "\nN = ", group_stats$N),
    group_stats$diabetes
  )

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # Y SCALING (CLEAN)
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  y_max <- max(plot_data$labreads, na.rm = TRUE)

  n_label_y <- y_max * 1.08
  pvalue_y  <- y_max * 1.05
  plot_top   <- y_max * 1.15

  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  # P VALUE
  #═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  counts <- table(plot_data$diabetes)

  if (length(counts) == 2 && all(counts >= 3)) {

    pvals <- plot_data %>%
      wilcox_test(labreads ~ diabetes) %>%
      mutate(
        group1 = "Diabetic",
        group2 = "Non_Diabetic",
        y.position = pvalue_y,
        p.label = paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3))
      )

  } else {
    pvals <- tibble()
  }

##═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
## PLOT
##═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = diabetes,
      y = labreads,
      fill = diabetes,
      colour = diabetes
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.45,
      alpha = 0.35,
      linewidth = 0.8,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +

    geom_text(
      data = group_stats,
      aes(
        x = diabetes,
        y = n_label_y,
        label = paste0("n = ", n)
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 8
    ) +

    {
      if (nrow(pvals) > 0)
        stat_pvalue_manual(
          pvals,
          label = "p.label",
          xmin = "group1",
          xmax = "group2",
          y.position = "y.position",
          tip.length = 0.01,
          bracket.size = 0.3,
          size = 8
        )
    } +

    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +

    scale_y_break(
      y_break,
      scales = y_break_scale
    ) +

    expand_limits(y = plot_top) +

    guides(y = "prism_offset_minor") +

    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      subtitle = " ",
      x = NULL,
      y = y_label
    ) +

    theme_prism() +

    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      legend.position = "none",

      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 25,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(b = 10)
      ),

      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 1)
      ),

      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.title = element_text(
        size = 24,
        face = "bold"
      ),

      axis.title.y = element_text(
        margin = margin(r = -10, unit = "pt")
      ),

      axis.text.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x.top = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x.top = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(
        t = top_margin,
        r = 10,
        b = 10,
        l = 10,
        unit = "pt"
      )
    )

  return(p)
}
```


```{r}
p <- plot_diabetes_boxplot_break(
  all_data,
  diabetic_data,
  panel = "cholinesterase",
  plot_title = "Cholinesterase: Diabetic vs Non-Diabetic",
  unit_map = unit_map,
  y_break = c(20000,65000),
  y_break_scale = 0.4
)

p
```
